The strongest reported intercept is an extension of prior mineralization; true thickness is not yet known.
A broad, lower-grade interval may indicate a larger mineralized envelope, but its relationship to the main sulphide horizon needs confirmation.
Pending assays could materially change the assessment of grade, thickness and continuity.
Exploration Target update planned for January 2027
The update may provide a more defined scale estimate, but no mineral resource has been established.

This is an early-stage exploration update, with reported assays adding to the company's ongoing effort to establish Kraken Main's scale and continuity. The next catalysts are remaining assays, including from sulphide-rich intervals, and the planned January 2027 Exploration Target update.
